The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`systemContext library "SystemContext"`), so there's one image.

What it contains, matching the C4-PlantUML export of your DSL:
- **Title:** "System Context View: Library"
- **Person** "Patron" (Borrows books at the library.) → **Software System** "Library" (Manages books and loans.)
- **Relationship:** "Browses the catalogue through" / HTTPS
- C4-standard colors (#0E70C1 person, #1168BD system) and a legend

One note on process: this environment has no PlantUML/Java/Node renderer and no external network access, so instead of piping the exported `.puml` through a renderer, I hand-built the SVG directly from the Structurizr export (validated as well-formed XML). If you'd rather have PNGs, or want the intermediate `SystemContext.puml`/`.mmd` source files saved alongside, say the word.
